title: Saturday's boring SaaS, 24 October 2026
dek: Saturday, 24 October 2026. Six are Stripe-verified, including a newer Conductor number. Kibu's figure is the April sync. The Stripe key expired. P7M is RevenueCat-verified. The German bookkeeping listing has no company name, and that one, plus Tratta, BoosterHub, and Vantaca, are self-reported.

companies.name: Anonymous German bookkeeping sync
companies.description: A solo tool that syncs Stripe into German bookkeeping tools. The Acquire listing does not name the company or give a product site.
companies.evidence: Self-reported, with a P&L attached. $158K revenue and $120K profit over the last 12 months. Last month $16.4K revenue and $12.5K profit. $126.4K ARR, up 168% a year. 500–999 customers, 1–3% churn, founded May 2022. Asking $523K, which is 4.5x profit.
companies.indieAngle: German bookkeeping rules are the product. The listing is the note. There is no company name to build on.
companies.whyItPrints: It is the glue between Stripe and the books a German company already keeps. One person, a P&L attached to the listing, and an asking price.

companies.name: Khosmos
companies.description: Quote + e-sign + invoicing + payments for French construction pros and micro-entreprises (1–50 people / subcontractors). Create a full quote in under a minute, sign on-site or remotely, then bill. ~€24/mo + per-seat, annual plans available.
companies.evidence: $22,257 MRR, 843 subscriptions, $373K all-time. €23.99 a month. Noted 24 October 2026. The 1 October note was about $21.9k MRR, 834 subscriptions, and about $355k all-time.
companies.indieAngle: One trade, one country, and the e-invoicing deadline is the reason they stay.
companies.whyItPrints: Tradespeople lose deals when quotes are slow. Khosmos owns the quote→cash workflow in one country vertical — same shape as Conductor (legacy/ops glue) and Calendesk (country booking), but for French chantier admin.

companies.name: P7M.io
companies.description: Opens the signed .p7m files Italy requires. €3.99 per document. Solo, started in March, and the listing is for sale. The listing does not give a product site.
companies.evidence: $537 MRR, $4,279 in the last 30 days. €3.99 per document. Solo, started in March, for sale. Noted 24 October 2026.
companies.indieAngle: One file format, one country, pay per document.
companies.whyItPrints: Italian invoices and official files arrive as a signed .p7m. People pay per document so they can open it.

companies.name: Calendesk
companies.description: B2B booking + payments + client portal for therapists, psychologists, coaches, lawyers, beauty/fitness — white-label, subscription packages, API-first. Polish-founded, bootstrapped since 2020.
companies.evidence: $21,183 MRR, $1.15M all-time. Bootstrapped since 2020. Noted 24 October 2026. The 30 September note was about $21.5k MRR and about $1.13M all-time.
companies.indieAngle: A booking page for one profession, in one city, is the smaller version.
companies.whyItPrints: Service pros already schedule and take deposits every day. Calendesk owns that workflow at ~$79–$147/mo instead of inventing a new category.

companies.name: LegalOne
companies.description: French annonces légales (legal notices) publishing — accountants and companies file required notices with competitive rates and compliance baked in. Bootstrapped, France.
companies.evidence: $10,712 in the last 30 days, $102K all-time. Charged per notice. Noted 24 October 2026. The 1 October note was about $10.7k in the last 30 days and about $93k all-time.
companies.indieAngle: A notice the law already requires, billed once per filing.
companies.whyItPrints: Legal notices are mandatory, price-sensitive, and accountant-distributed. Transaction revenue (not seat MRR) with ~$11k L30 and ~917 users claimed — classic country compliance marketplace.

companies.name: Send Letters Online UK
companies.description: Type a letter in the browser; they print, fold, frank, and post via Royal Mail from £2.99. Volume discounts from 100 letters/month. Founded May 2026, UK. GDPR / ICO registered (company-stated). Pay-per-letter, not seat SaaS.
companies.evidence: $4,125 in the last 30 days, $22.9K all-time since May. Noted 24 October 2026. The 12 October note was about $4,283 in the last 30 days and about $21,160 all-time.
companies.indieAngle: The API is for the letters a landlord or a solicitor has to send, not for birthday cards.
companies.whyItPrints: Courts, landlords, SMEs, and public sector still need physical post. Hybrid mail is dull infrastructure with tangible COGS and sticky repeat volume.
companies.imageAlt: Send Letters Online UK product image

companies.name: Tratta
companies.description: Debt-collection software. The article says about $5M ARR, around 100 clients, revenue doubled in a year, and the company never raised. Company-stated. The article is not a product site.
companies.evidence: Company-stated, from a Practical Founders article. About $5M ARR, around 100 clients, revenue doubled in a year, never raised.
companies.indieAngle: Collections is a job people already pay staff to do.
companies.whyItPrints: Collectors already have the job. Software that runs the chase is a dull purchase.

companies.name: BoosterHub
companies.description: All-in-one software, accounting included, for US high-school booster clubs. The article says close to $1M ARR, 2 full-time staff, and about 600 programs. Company-stated. The article is not a product site.
companies.evidence: Company-stated, from a Practical Founders article. Close to $1M ARR, 2 full-time staff, about 600 programs.
companies.indieAngle: One kind of volunteer treasurer, one country, the books included.
companies.whyItPrints: A booster club has to collect money, keep the books, and show parents where it went. Two people selling that to hundreds of clubs is the whole story in the article.

companies.name: Kibu
companies.description: Content, compliance, and EHR platform built specifically for provider organizations serving people with intellectual and developmental disabilities (I/DD). Helps DSPs deliver care while managing regulatory documentation across hundreds of orgs and ~48 US states. HIPAA-compliant; contact-sales pricing. Founded Jan 2022, US.
companies.evidence: $234K MRR. The Stripe key expired. Revenue last synced 19 April 2026. This 24 October note is that same stale figure, not a new sync.
companies.indieAngle: The buyer cannot skip the paperwork. The number on the page is from April.
companies.whyItPrints: Pure regulated vertical ops software — the Conductor shape applied to disability services. Providers cannot improvise compliance; once the EHR + care logs live in Kibu, switching costs explode. High ACV B2B seats (375 subs → ~$234k MRR) without consumer virality.

companies.name: Vantaca
companies.description: HOA management software priced per home. The company says $85M revenue at the end of 2025, after about 5 years bootstrapped. Company-stated, from a Latka article. The article is not a product site.
companies.evidence: Company-stated, from a Latka article. $85M revenue at the end of 2025, after about 5 years bootstrapped.
companies.indieAngle: Per home, not per login. The association is the customer.
companies.whyItPrints: A homeowner association already pays someone to run the dues, the repairs, and the letters. The software is priced per home.

companies.name: Conductor
companies.description: The QuickBooks Desktop and Enterprise API. $49 per company file per month to read and write the file over REST, Python, or Node, instead of the Web Connector and qbXML (founder-stated). Founder Danny Nemer, US, founded July 2022. The 24 October listing is for sale. Stripe shows a higher monthly number than the 20 October note.
companies.evidence: $44,349 MRR, up 10% month over month. An April interview put the figure at about $25K (company-stated). The listing is now for sale. Noted 24 October 2026. The 20 October note was $43,330 MRR and 284 subscriptions.
companies.indieAngle: Same QuickBooks Desktop API as the earlier notes. The Stripe number moved up, and it is for sale.
companies.whyItPrints: Developers still pay so QuickBooks Desktop behaves like a normal API. The new number is higher, and the listing is now for sale.
